title: Coastrek Mornington Peninsula 2026
summary: Team hiking challenge supporting Beyond Blue mental health. Choose 20km (Sorrento to Point Nepean), 30km (Point Nepean loop), or 50km (Cape Schanck to Point Nepean). Teams of 2 or more. Coastal bush trails and clifftop tracks. 6am start.
